response.description: A fuel oil which is 1) composed primarily of alkanes having between 5-15 carbon atoms with the general formula CnH2n+2, 2) is generally odorless or has only a slight odor, 3) produces only small amounts of soot relative to other fuel oils, 4) is highly refined.
response.label: paraffin oil

response.description: For speakers of British English, kerosene is often referred to as paraffin.
response.label: kerosene oil
